crossRefs.note: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and…
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…

translations.web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
translations.bsb: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
translations.kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
translations.asv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death. Psalm 49 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
